minutes_text:
Library Board
  MINUTES – September 27, 2023
The Inglewood Library Board met on September 27, 2023, via Zoom. Board Member Jacqueline Cochran
called the meeting to order at 4:34 p.m.
Roll Call

Present:
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy City Manager
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Management Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for September 27, 2023.
  Board Member Castillo seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

Library Report

Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh gave the board members construction updates on Morningside Park
Library and shared some construction progress pictures.
Mr. Singh also gave updates on the Main Library renovation, which will take 14 to 15 months to build, the
Library van, and the community meeting at the Main Library, including the Mayor and people joining through
Zoom and Hispanic Heritage event with great feedback.
Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh explained the construction process and stated that Crenshaw Imperial
Branch and Morningside Library will be open to provide services during the Main Library renovation.

Board member Ernesto Castillo asked how much natural light would get into the Morningside Library building.

Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh stated that it's a requirement that was asked for. However, there are
limitations, and the architects will be challenged to deliver as much light as possible.
 Library Manager Kerri Arroyo provided the board members with the Crenshaw Library update, including the
patio, parking lot, furniture, carpeting, and the newly installed windows.
The Library Manager also discussed the Main Library renovation survey and her responses to them. She
also stated that the library newsletter has photos of the Morningside Library renovation progress, and the
website features the Morningside Branch Library progress with a timeline and photos located under Library
Services.
Library Manager Kerri Arroyo also gave updates on outreach, school visits, class visits, giveaways for
kids/families, successful children’s programming, the Teen Advisory Board, the Art Therapy program, the
Hispanic Heritage Festival with 700 participants, an Internship from UCLA, computer, and ESL classes.

Kerri Arroyo invited board members to the library to see the Halloween Display.

Board Member Castillo asked if he could get pictures of the classes sent to him and expressed his ideas
about Halloween. He was pleased with the construction updates.

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that they would send pictures showcasing IUSD class visits to Mr.
Castillo.

Board Member Cochran asked about the food program.

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that the Crenshaw Library has a food program lunch service all year
round. It will also be at the Main Library on Monday, beginning October 2, for the first time in a long time. It
will be a snack and dinner, so both sites will be honored to be able to provide that service to both library
communities.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

Board Member Castillo thanked Harjinder and Kerri for the great information and excellent job and said he
passed by the library booth at the Hispanic Heritage Festival. The library had great giveaways, and the
community was pleased. He wants to keep a strong bridge between the school districts and the library. Board
member Castillo thanked board member Cochran for being a great leader and mentoring some of the
principals and teachers at Inglewood Unified School District.

Board member Douglas thanked Kerri and Harjinder for the great library report and colorful newsletter emails.

Board member Cochran thanked board members Douglas and Castillo for their great comments. She also
thanked Harjinder and Kerri for the excellent community meeting open forum at the library; it was well-
organized, and people felt comfortable making comments. She applauds Kerri and the team for doing a great
job.

With no further comments, the meeting adjourned at 5:24 p.m.
